name: Golnir Bouldertoe
summary: Golnir Bouldertoe is a dwarven mining vendor stationed beside the bustling Great Forge in Ironforge. He provides essential supplies for miners and prospectors while handling dispatches for local couriers and travelers.

sections.title: Merchant of the Great Forge
sections.body: Standing within the roaring heat of Ironforge's Great Forge, Golnir Bouldertoe outfits prospectors and craftsmen with the necessities of their trade. From sturdy mining picks to fluxes and coal, his wares fuel the tireless smelting fires and smithies that define the dwarven capital. Kin to Geofram Bouldertoe, Golnir is a reliable point of contact for workers arriving in the city, often directing fresh hands or receiving supply missives shuttled in from nearby outposts.

faq.q: Where can I find Golnir Bouldertoe?
faq.answer: Golnir Bouldertoe is located in the Great Forge in Ironforge, standing near the central smelting and blacksmithing areas alongside fellow trade merchants.
He serves as a mining supplier, selling essential trade gear such as mining picks, coal, fluxes, and mining sacks to assist prospectors in hauling and refining raw ore.

faq.q: Is Golnir Bouldertoe involved in any quests?
faq.answer: Yes. Courier quests connecting surrounding dwarven settlements to the capital, such as errands involving Gryth Thurden and incoming flights from outposts like Thelsamar, direct travelers to deliver messages directly into Golnir's hands.

faq.q: Is Golnir related to anyone else in Dun Morogh?
faq.answer: Golnir shares his clan name with Geofram Bouldertoe, the mining trainer who works beside him in the Great Forge of Ironforge.

angles.text: Miners visiting the Great Forge rely on Golnir for vital tools of the craft, including spare picks and fluxes needed to smelt raw vein-work into refined bars.
For dwarves returning from their first journeys out in Coldridge or Kharanos, Golnir serves as an early contact in the capital, welcoming travelers right beside the mountain's fiery heart.
